text:
raj: Heads up — deploybot blocked release 2026.03.21 (artifact v2.14.0). SBOM signature missing and vuln-scan reported a transitive low/medium finding in libfoo (CVE-2024-xyz). Need quick decision: pin/rollback, partial rollout, or timeboxed exception?

deploy-bot: [deploy-check] SBOM signature: MISSING. vuln-scan: 0 high, 1 medium (transitive), 2 low. Canary policy: BLOCK.

olga: pinging @emily (security) and @alex (legal). This is inside the EU change window — we have until 23:00 UTC for a clean release unless we get an exception.

emily: On it. Quick read: CVE-2024-xyz is in a build-time dependency used only during packaging, not shipped runtime. Exploitability looks low. Root cause: cosign step failed in CI so the signed SBOM wasn't attached.

cedric: Operational constraints: we can do a regional 5% EU canary, but our gating policy prevents any rollout until SBOM is signed OR an explicit exception is recorded. Ops can't override without a security signoff.

olga: Proposed path: 1) manually attach signature to artifact, 2) re-run vuln scan, 3) if no new medium/high findings, allow a timeboxed 2-hour 5% EU canary with strict rollback triggers. That keeps release momentum while limiting blast radius.

emily: That sounds fine to me conditionally: I will approve a 2-hour timeboxed exception if we (a) attach signature now, (b) re-run vuln-scan and confirm no new med/high, and (c) auto-rollback on the defined SLO/alert criteria.

alex: Legal: we need an attestation comment in the release notes and a ticket for post-release SBOM audit. If security signs off on the exception and engineering documents the fix & timeline, legal will OK.

raj: I'll run the manual cosign now. Command: 
```
cosign sign --key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/release-key artifact-v2.14.0.tar.gz
```

deploy-bot: cosign step started...

deploy-bot: cosign: OK — signature attached to artifact-v2.14.0.tar.gz (sha256:abcd1234). SBOM updated and uploaded to storage at s3://redwood-sboms/2026-03-21/v2.14.0.sbom.json

raj: re-running vuln-scan: `./tools/vuln-scan --sbom s3://.../v2.14.0.sbom.json`

deploy-bot: vuln-scan complete: 0 high, 0 medium, 1 low (transitive, libfoo). No new med/high.

emily: Security here — approving temporary exception for a 2-hour EU 5% canary. Conditions: auto-rollback if error rate >2x baseline OR if any new medium/high vuln appears on re-scan. I will monitor and will revoke if anything suspicious. :white_check_mark:

alex: Legal approves contingent on release notes + post-release audit ticket. Please add the attestation text.

olga: Draft release note line: "Signed SBOM attached post-scan; transient build-tool CVE assessed low. Starting 5% EU canary for 2 hours under monitoring; rollback criteria defined." Will add to notes now.

raj: Canary kickoff: deploying EU 5% canary with feature flag `eu_canary_v2_14_0=true`. Monitor rigs: latency, error-rate, CPU/GPU OOMs, inference anomaly alerts.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started — region: eu-west-1, traffic: 5%, start_ts: 3512346905. Auto-rollback timer set: 2h (will trigger at 3512354105) unless earlier rollback conditions met.

cedric: Monitoring hooks added to the release: alert if 5xxs > 2x baseline or p95 latency > +150ms for 5m window. Ops oncall: @cedric on duty.

olga: Thanks all. If no issues in 2 hours, we proceed to full rollout outside of EU change window gating and close the SBOM audit ticket in postmortem. :thumbsup:

emily: I'll keep an eye and post updates if I revoke.

raj: Will update thread with final outcome and link to audit ticket.

deploy-bot: Canary running. Thread will be auto-archived after 24h.
